buddies.name: Rajesh Kumar Sharma
buddies.bio: Born and raised in Old Delhi. I know every gali, every hidden gem, and the best parathas you'll ever taste. Let me show you the Delhi that guidebooks miss.

services.description: 3-hour street food crawl covering Chandni Chowk, Paranthe Wali Gali, and hidden local joints
Offbeat Delhi tour: Hauz Khas Village, Lodhi Art District, hidden Mughal ruins
Complete Delhi experience: Heritage + Modern + Food + Markets (8 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Rajesh showed us the real Delhi. Maps would've never taken us to those places!

buddies.name: Ananya Mishra
buddies.bio: Varanasi is not just a city—it's a feeling. I grew up on the ghats, learned yoga from sadhus, and know every sunrise spot. Let me decode Kashi for you.

services.description: Authentic Banarasi food tour: Kachori, lassi, chaat, and sweets from 100-year-old shops
Offbeat Varanasi: Lesser-known ghats, artisan workshops, silk weavers, mud pottery villages
Spiritual Varanasi immersion: Sunrise boat ride, ghats, temples, evening aarti, local life (7 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Ananya made us feel safe and explained every ritual. Best guide we've ever had.

buddies.name: Rohan D'Souza
buddies.bio: Forget Baga and Calangute. I'll take you to secret beaches, spice plantations, and the real Goan villages where my grandparents still live.

services.description: Authentic Goan seafood tour: Family-run beach shacks, hidden fish curry spots, feni tasting
Secret Goa: Abandoned forts, hidden waterfalls, artisan villages, sunset viewpoints
Complete Goa package: Beaches, heritage, nightlife, markets, adventure (10 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Rohan showed us beaches we never knew existed. Google Maps failed, he didn't!

buddies.name: Meera Chauhan
buddies.bio: I grew up in the shadow of palaces. I know which rooftop cafes have the best lake views, which markets sell real handicrafts, and when to visit temples for peace.

services.description: Royal Rajasthani food trail: Dal Baati Churma, rooftop restaurants, sweet shops
Beyond City Palace: Hidden havelis, artisan workshops, Bagore ki Haveli evening show
Udaipur luxury experience: Palaces, boat rides, markets, sunset, dinner (8 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Meera's knowledge of Udaipur's history is unmatched. She made every palace come alive.

buddies.name: Arjun Nair
buddies.bio: Born in tea estates, raised in the hills. I know every trekking path, tea garden, waterfall, and the best time to see Neelakurinji bloom.

services.description: Kerala cuisine tour: Appam, stew, banana chips, local toddy shops (family-friendly options)
Offbeat Munnar: Echo Point alternatives, hidden waterfalls, tea workers' villages
Complete Munnar immersion: Tea estates, trekking, wildlife, waterfalls, markets (9 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Arjun took us trekking to places Google Maps doesn't even show. Unforgettable experience!

buddies.name: Vikram Singh Rathore
buddies.bio: My family has lived in Jaipur for seven generations. I can tell you stories about Hawa Mahal that even architects don't know.

services.description: Royal Jaipur food tour: Laal Maas, Ghewar, LMB sweets, rooftop cafes
Hidden Jaipur: Panna Meena Kund, Galtaji Temple, artisan colonies, stepwells
Complete Pink City: Amber Fort, City Palace, markets, jewelry, block printing (9 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Vikram's architectural knowledge is incredible. He showed us Jaipur through an expert's eyes.

buddies.name: Priya Agarwal
buddies.bio: Agra is more than the Taj. I'll show you the real Mughal city, marble workshops, and food that locals guard like secrets.

services.description: Agra street food: Petha varieties, Bedai, Jalebi, hidden biryani spots
Beyond Taj: Fatehpur Sikri, Itmad-ud-Daulah, Mehtab Bagh sunset, marble workshops
Complete Agra: Taj Mahal, fort, markets, marble craft, food (8 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Priya helped us see Taj at sunrise with almost no crowd. Perfect experience!

buddies.name: Aditya Mehta
buddies.bio: Mumbai is my heartbeat. From Dharavi tours to Bollywood studio visits, I'll show you the city's real pulse beyond Marine Drive.

services.description: Mumbai food marathon: Vada pav, pav bhaji, seafood, Irani cafe, chaat
Real Mumbai: Dharavi, Dhobi Ghat, Chor Bazaar, Kala Ghoda Art District
Complete Mumbai: Gateway, markets, Bollywood studio, street food, nightlife (10 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Aditya made Mumbai accessible and safe. The Dharavi tour was eye-opening and respectful.

buddies.name: Sourav Chatterjee
buddies.bio: Kolkata isn't just a city, it's poetry in motion. Let me take you through Tagore's lanes, colonial architecture, and rosogolla shops.

services.description: Bengali food tour: Rosogolla, mishti doi, fish curry, Kolkata biryani, street rolls
Offbeat Kolkata: Kumartuli, College Street, Marble Palace, tram ride, Princep Ghat
Complete Kolkata: Victoria Memorial, Howrah Bridge, markets, literature spots, food (8 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Sourav brought Kolkata's literary soul to life. Best cultural tour we've ever experienced.

buddies.name: Fatima Khan
buddies.bio: Hyderabad's Nizami culture runs in my blood. I know which biryani shop actually uses the dum method and where to buy real pearls.

services.description: Hyderabadi food trail: Authentic biryani, haleem, Irani chai, Osmania biscuits, street food
Hidden Hyderabad: Paigah Tombs, Taramati Baradari, Qutb Shahi Tombs, pearl market
Complete Hyderabad: Charminar, Golconda Fort, markets, biryani, pearls (9 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Fatima's knowledge of Nizami heritage is exceptional. She helped us find authentic pearls!

buddies.name: Karthik Raman
buddies.bio: Chennai's temple architecture, Carnatic music, and filter coffee culture are my expertise. Let me show you the city's classical soul.

services.description: Authentic Chennai food: Filter coffee, idli varieties, Chettinad cuisine, street snacks
Cultural Chennai: Dakshinachitra, Mahabalipuram, silk saree shops, classical music venue
Complete Chennai: Temples, Marina Beach, markets, music, silk, food (8 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Karthik explained Tamil culture beautifully. The temple tour was deeply enlightening.

buddies.name: Sneha Rao
buddies.bio: Bangalore is where tradition meets tech. I'll show you ancient temples, craft beer breweries, and startup culture in one day.

services.description: Bangalore food tour: South Indian breakfast, street food, craft beer, coffee culture
Modern Bangalore: Cubbon Park, Lalbagh, microbreweries, bookshops, startup hubs
Complete Bangalore: Palaces, gardens, temples, breweries, markets, tech culture (9 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Sneha perfectly balanced Bangalore's old and new. Great brewery recommendations!

buddies.name: Ravi Patel
buddies.bio: Ahmedabad's textile heritage, Gandhian history, and vegetarian food culture are what I live and breathe. Let me decode this UNESCO city for you.

services.description: Gujarati vegetarian food tour: Thali, Khakhra, Dhokla, Fafda, sweet shops
Heritage Ahmedabad: Old city pols, step wells, textile museum, Calico Museum
Complete Ahmedabad: Sabarmati Ashram, heritage pols, textiles, kite museum, food (8 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Ravi's textile knowledge is phenomenal. The heritage walk was absolutely enriching.

buddies.name: Aditi Kulkarni
buddies.bio: Pune's forts, trekking trails, and wellness culture are my playground. I'll take you beyond cafes to the real Maratha heartland.

services.description: Pune food tour: Misal pav, bhakarwadi, mastani, German bakery, street chaat
Adventure Pune: Sinhagad Fort trek, Shaniwar Wada, Aga Khan Palace, local markets
Complete Pune: Fort trek, heritage, wellness centers, cafes, markets (9 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Aditi made the Sinhagad trek unforgettable. Her Maratha history knowledge is impressive!

buddies.name: Rahul Menon
buddies.bio: Kochi's colonial past, spice trade history, and backwater secrets are in my DNA. I grew up watching ships from five continents dock here.

services.description: Kochi seafood tour: Fish curry, appam, prawns, Syrian Christian cuisine, toddy shops
Colonial Kochi: Fort Kochi, Mattancherry Palace, Jew Town, spice markets, Chinese nets
Complete Kochi: Backwaters, heritage sites, spice tour, seafood, markets (8 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Rahul's maritime knowledge brought Kochi's history alive. Best backwater tour ever!

buddies.name: Mahendra Singh
buddies.bio: The Blue City's rooftops, desert safaris, and Mehrangarh's secrets are what I photograph daily. Let me show you Jodhpur's soul.

services.description: Marwari food tour: Mirchi bada, makhania lassi, pyaaz kachori, sweets, rooftop cafes
Blue City exploration: Rooftop walks, step wells, Toorji Ka Jhalra, artisan quarters
Complete Jodhpur: Mehrangarh Fort, blue city, desert safari, markets, sunset (10 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Mahendra's photography tips transformed our shots. The blue city walk was magical!

buddies.name: Kavita Sharma
buddies.bio: Rishikesh raised me with the Ganga's rhythm. I teach yoga, guide rafting trips, and know every ashram's vibe. Let me show you the real yoga capital.

services.description: Rishikesh vegetarian tour: Sattvic cafes, ashram food, Chotiwala, organic cafes
Spiritual Rishikesh: Beatles Ashram, Parmarth Niketan aarti, Neer Garh waterfall, meditation spots
Complete Rishikesh: Yoga session, rafting, ashrams, waterfalls, aarti (7 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Kavita's yoga and spiritual knowledge is profound. She made Rishikesh deeply meaningful.

buddies.name: Sanjay Joshi
buddies.bio: Golden Temple's spirituality, partition history, and authentic Punjabi dhaba culture flow through my veins. Let me share Amritsar's heart.

services.description: Punjabi food tour: Amritsari kulcha, lassi, makki di roti, authentic dhabas, street food
Heritage Amritsar: Partition Museum, Jallianwala Bagh, Gobindgarh Fort, heritage walk
Complete Amritsar: Golden Temple, Wagah Border, heritage sites, food, markets (9 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Sanjay explained Sikh history with such depth. The Golden Temple experience was spiritual.

buddies.name: Lakshmi Venkatesh
buddies.bio: Madurai's temple architecture, Dravidian culture, and jasmine market stories are my life's work. Let me decode this ancient city.

services.description: Madurai food tour: Jigarthanda, parotta, Chettinad meals, street snacks, sweets
Cultural Madurai: Thirumalai Nayak Palace, Gandhi Museum, flower market, silk sarees
Complete Madurai: Meenakshi Temple, markets, palace, food, evening ceremony (7 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Lakshmi's temple architecture knowledge is extraordinary. Madurai came alive through her stories.

buddies.name: Tenzin Dorje
buddies.bio: Darjeeling's tea estates, Himalayan views, and Tibetan culture are in my blood. I'll show you the real Queen of Hills beyond tourist spots.

services.description: Darjeeling food tour: Momos, thukpa, tea tasting, bakeries, Tibetan cuisine
Offbeat Darjeeling: Batasia Loop, Peace Pagoda, Himalayan Railway, monasteries, tea gardens
Complete Darjeeling: Tiger Hill sunrise, tea estates, toy train, monasteries, markets (8 hours)

reviews_snapshot.comment: Tenzin's tea knowledge is impressive. The sunrise trek to Tiger Hill was breathtaking!

metadata.cancellation_policy: 24-48 hours advance notice required for full refund depending on tour type
